invariants.contract: GET /api/tasks returns {tasks:[...]} where a running embed task carries id, action embed-metadata, title "Embedding Metadata" with titleKey MessageTaskEmbeddingMetadata and null titleSubs, description "Embedding metadata in audiobook \"<title>\"." with MessageTaskEmbeddingMetadataDescription and descriptionSubs [title], showSuccess/isFailed/isFinished false, a numeric startedAt, null finishedAt and null error fields, and data.libraryItemId with the item's audio paths and cache paths; with ?include=queue it adds queuedTaskData.embedMetadata holding the waiting tasks' data in submission (FIFO) order with their requested options.

GET /api/tasks is behind the global API authentication gate but no admin check: an anonymous request answers 401, an ordinary authenticated user receives the same 200 task list as an admin because the layout loads tasks for every user, and reading the route changes no task state.

With no task running the response is an empty tasks array and no queuedTaskData key; include=queue adds queuedTaskData.embedMetadata as an empty array (never null or absent), and an include value other than queue leaves queuedTaskData out.
